resources.string: Saving alone posts nothing. Approve the pattern to switch it on, then apply it to matching messages.

After saving, the pattern is checked again with its previous approval settings. If the check passes it stays approved; otherwise approve it again.

From settings: choose a bank and paste an example. From review: the message and sender are prefilled and the original text stays unchanged.
